text:
On March 15, 2024, at approximately 2:30 PM, John Smith, while lawfully waiting at a red traffic signal on Main Street at First Avenue in Springfield, CA, was rear-ended by a vehicle operated by Sarah Johnson. The intersection was controlled by traffic signals, and Mr. Smith was stationary with the right-of-way when Ms. Johnson, traveling eastbound on Main Street, failed to stop and struck Mr. Smith's vehicle from behind.

The accident was witnessed by several pedestrians and captured on nearby surveillance cameras. Upon the arrival of the responding officer, a citation was issued to Ms. Johnson for inattentive driving. Weather conditions were clear, dry, and visibility was good due to dry pavement. Ms. Johnson admitted to being distracted by her phone at the time of the collision.
